Maya (Product): Heads-up: Prospect Meridian Health asked for 7-year audit retention + per-tenant BYOK with auditor handoff (they insisted on HSM-backed keys). Need quick triage for contract language.

Jin (Security): Important. We need to confirm whether Meridian requires key escrow to auditor or just signed export bundles. Also define what 'HSM-backed' means (FIPS 140-2 vs FIPS 140-3).

Sam (CS): Meridian says auditors must be able to verify exported logs and that keys are tenant-specific. They prefer a one-time escrow option for audits only.

Priya (EngInfra): Feasible approach: keep 90d hot indexed, 2y warm semi-indexed, remainder cold export-only. Cold kept encrypted in long-term object storage. Export bundles signed with tenant key.

Lars (SRE): We'll implement export job with 24h SLA for cold retrieval. Add rate limits and require explicit export approvals to prevent abuse.

Nora (Finance): 7yr increases storage cost materially; propose per-GB monthly uplift + retrieval fee per export. I'll draft numbers.

Maya (Product): MVP ask for sales/legal: 1) BYOK handshake (tenant keys), 2) signed export bundle with manifest, 3) retention tiers + retrieval SLA, 4) sample contract blurb. Anything else mandatory?

Jin (Security): Add: key rotation policy, attestation doc that we never persist plaintext after envelope, and a threat model snippet. Mark HSM/FIPS as enterprise feature.

Priya (EngInfra): Implementation notes: BYOK handshake (wrap/unwrap flow), periodic attestation ping, /audit/export API payload {tenant,start,end,destination} returning signed manifest. We'll add RFC and link.

Maya (Product): Owners & dates: Jin - security checklist + attestation (due 2025-02-10); Priya - tech design + estimate (due 2025-02-06); Lars - ops runbook + throttling rules (due 2025-02-14); Nora - pricing uplift (due 2025-01-30); Sam - customer/legal sample language (due 2025-02-04).

Sam (CS): Meridian wants pilot in June; they asked for a short compliance one-pager by next Wed. I'll prepare and sync with legal.

Maya (Product): Ok. We'll treat as sales-triggered enterprise. If Meridian signs LOI we'll fast-track into Feb sprint. Reconvene Mon to confirm capacity. Thanks. :thumbsup:
